import sys,json
from fractions import Fraction
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor');sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import controller,metrics,probability

def check(reqpath,respath):
 req=json.load(open(reqpath));res=json.load(open(respath));assert res['version']==3 and len(res['results'])==len(req['cases'])
 for case,r in zip(req['cases'],res['results']):
  pr=case['class_values']; wins=case['windows']; S=len(case['slots']);J=len(wins);F=len(case['flows']);G=len(case['groups'])
  th=probability.window_thresholds(case['stats'],wins)
  assert r['thresholds']==th
  # build nodes manually
  K,R,Z=2+3*S+J+F+G,0,1
  a=[2+3*s for s in range(S)];b=[3+3*s for s in range(S)];e=[4+3*s for s in range(S)]
  w=[2+3*S+j for j in range(J)];z=[2+3*S+J+f for f in range(F)];h=[2+3*S+J+F+g for g in range(G)]
  bucket_cap,I=case['bucket'];val=[wins[j][6]*pr[r['predictions'][j]] for j in range(J)];W=1+J*case['slots'][-1][0]
  arcs=[]
  for s,(tm,cap,rf) in enumerate(case['slots']):
   arcs += [(R,a[s],0,I if s==0 else rf,0),(a[s],b[s],0,bucket_cap,0)]
   if s+1<S:arcs.append((b[s],a[s+1],0,bucket_cap,0))
   arcs.append((b[s],e[s],0,cap,0))
  elig_info=[]
  for s,(tm,cap,rf) in enumerate(case['slots']):
   for j,win in enumerate(wins):
    if win[5]<th[j] and win[1]<=tm<=win[2]:
     elig_info.append((len(arcs),s,j));arcs.append((e[s],w[j],0,1,(tm-win[1])-val[j]*W))
  for j in range(J):arcs.append((w[j],z[wins[j][0]],0,1,0))
  rfrac=Fraction(*r['ratio']);fidx=[]
  for f,(target,ceiling,group,label) in enumerate(case['flows']):
   lo=(rfrac.numerator*target+rfrac.denominator-1)//rfrac.denominator
   p=Z if group==-1 else h[group];fidx.append(len(arcs));arcs.append((z[f],p,lo,ceiling,0))
  for g,(parent,ceiling) in enumerate(case['groups']):arcs.append((h[g],Z if parent==-1 else h[parent],0,ceiling,0))
  arcs.append((Z,R,0,J,0))
  ff=r['flow'];pot=r['potential'];ass=r['assignment'];assert len(ff)==len(arcs) and len(pot)==K and len(ass)==J
  for i,(u,v,l,hh,c) in enumerate(arcs):
   x=ff[i];assert type(x) is int and l<=x<=hh
   rc=c+pot[u]-pot[v]
   if x<hh:assert rc>=0,(i,rc)
   if x>l:assert -rc>=0,(i,rc)
  bal=[0]*K
  for (u,v,l,hh,c),x in zip(arcs,ff):bal[u]+=x;bal[v]-=x
  assert not any(bal)
  for eid,s,j in elig_info:assert (ff[eid]==1)==(ass[j]==s),(eid,s,j)
  # coverage and utility age
  nf=[0]*F
  for j,s in enumerate(ass):
   if s>=0:nf[wins[j][0]]+=1
  cov=min(min(Fraction(1),Fraction(nf[f],case['flows'][f][0])) for f in range(F))
  assert cov==rfrac
  U=sum(val[j] for j,s in enumerate(ass) if s>=0);A=sum(case['slots'][s][0]-wins[j][1] for j,s in enumerate(ass) if s>=0)
  assert U==r['utility'] and A==r['age']
  # flow/group ceilings
  assert all(nf[f]<=case['flows'][f][1] for f in range(F))
  for g in range(G):
   tot=0
   for f,(t,c,gr,l) in enumerate(case['flows']):
    x=gr
    while x!=-1:
     if x==g:tot+=nf[f];break
     x=case['groups'][x][0]
   assert tot<=case['groups'][g][1]
  # cut
  Rset=sorted(set(Fraction(k,row[0]) for row in case['flows'] for k in range(row[0]+1)))
  if rfrac<1:
   nxt=Rset[Rset.index(rfrac)+1];assert r['cut'] is not None
   X=set(r['cut']);viol=0
   # build next lower arcs
   nextlo=[]
   for f,(target,ceiling,group,label) in enumerate(case['flows']):
    nextlo.append(((nxt.numerator*target+nxt.denominator-1)//nxt.denominator,z[f],Z if group==-1 else h[group]))
   # flow lower entering/upper leaving
   for u,v,l,hh,c in arcs:
    if u in X and v not in X:viol-=hh
    elif u not in X and v in X:viol+=l
   for lo,zz,pp in nextlo:
    # adjust from current lower to next
    old=arcs[fidx[0]] if False else None
   # easier recompute all arcs with next
   arcs2=[];fidx2=[]
   # repeat builder replacement using controller
  # reports
  rep=metrics.selected_report(case['flows'],wins,r['predictions'],ass)
  assert rep==r['reports']
 print(reqpath,'OK')
